summary: All 22 FRs and acceptance scenarios are implemented and tested with conformant red proofs, except rebind bypasses the ended-run writability ban and the FR-022 config guard misses valid-JSON-wrong-shape configs.

findings.summary: rebind can rewrite an ended (pr-open/aborted) run, diverging from FR-009 and the run's own contract delta.
findings.evidence: FR-009: 'A run that has ended MUST NOT be writable'; contracts/cli-delta.md 'write commands generally'. cmd_rebind uses one_run (858) and write_run (874) with no status check; the refusal lives only in resolve_target. The FR-009 test covers only pending selection.
findings.fix: Add the status guard to cmd_rebind matching resolve_target's message; add a test.

findings.summary: A config.json that parses but has the wrong shape crashes the installer with a traceback instead of the clean FR-022 refusal.
findings.evidence: install.sh guard (49-58) only json.loads; '[1,2]' or '{"models": 5}' passes, then config_models raises. 008 makes this path unconditional. Nothing rendered or linked.
findings.fix: Harden config_models (object checks, clean SystemExit naming the file); cover with a test.
